rule.title: Code Q, a qualified Roth IRA distribution: 4b is 0

citation.wording: You received a distribution from a Roth IRA. But if either (a) or (b) below applies, enter -0- on line 4b; you don't have to see Form 8606 or its instructions. a. Distribution code T is shown in box 7 of Form 1099-R and you made a contribution (including a conversion) to a Roth IRA for 2020 or an earlier year. b. Distribution code Q is shown in box 7 of Form 1099-R.

rule.open_point: Case (b), code Q, is decided by the paper and applied. Case (a), code T with a Roth contribution for 2020 or earlier, turns on a fact no 1099-R prints and waits for a question (spec 080 Phase 7); until then a code T figure is counted as printed.
